requirements.title: Mandatory Technical Data Erasure and Lifecycle Automation
requirements.requirement_text: Data Fiduciaries must implement automated lifecycle management rules on cloud storage buckets to archive or securely erase personal data once specified retention windows lapse.

requirements.title: Access Control and Multi-Factor Administrative Enforcement
requirements.requirement_text: Cloud environments handling sensitive and personal information must enforce least-privilege IAM policies, disallow root credential access, and enforce MFA for cloud operations.

requirements.title: Secure Application Code & Vulnerability Remediation Baseline
requirements.requirement_text: Web applications interacting with citizen personal data must pass static application security testing with zero high-severity unmitigated vulnerabilities or injection vectors.
